title: Cracking the Safe
description: Find the shortest string that contains all possible combinations of length n using k digits.
pseudocode:
1: function dfs(current_str, n, k, visited, total):
2:   if len(visited) == total:
3:     return current_str
4:   prev = current_str[-(n-1):]
5:   for i from 0 to k-1:
6:     next_node = prev + str(i)
7:     if next_node not in visited:
8:       visited.add(next_node)
9:       res = dfs(current_str + str(i), n, k, visited, total)
10:      if res: return res
11:      visited.remove(next_node)
